feature: ErosN-derived Reader volume-key navigation through HarmonyOS InputConsumer
official-api-basis: @kit/InputKit KeyCode and inputConsumer keyPressed; the foreground subscription intentionally consumes the system volume action while enabled and off restores it.
precondition: An existing complete app-private download was retained. The run records no account state, gallery text, page URL, image content, screenshot, or local file path.
steps: Keep the HDS Volume keys turn pages setting off by default, then explicitly enable it and reopen the native Reader.
Record only the page counter, inject HarmonyOS key code 17, and record the counter: 1 / 55 became 2 / 55.
Inject HarmonyOS key code 16 and record the counter: 2 / 55 became 1 / 55.
Return to HDS Settings, disable the preference, reopen Reader, inject key code 17, and confirm the safe counter remains 1 / 55.
result: Passed: the opt-in foreground consumer maps volume down to next and volume up to previous. With the setting disabled, the same volume-down code no longer navigates Reader.
cleanup: The durable preference was returned to off. All temporary device and host accessibility-layout files were removed; the app was returned to its root route and the normal 10000 ms screen-off timeout was restored.
